description: Speak, narrate, or deliver a conversational message to the user. Use this to explain your thoughts, describe visual observations, ask questions, or confirm task progress.
name: send_message

message.description: The natural language message to narrate to the user.

description: Smoothly interpolate motion to a 6-DOF joint target.
name: move_to_pose

duration_sec.description: Duration of the movement in seconds.

qpos.description: Target joint angles in degrees for all 6 joints.

description: Instant or snap joint position command to 6-DOF joint target.
name: set_joint_positions

qpos.description: Target joint angles in degrees for all 6 joints.

description: Read current joint state (informational, non-blocking). Returns degrees.
name: get_joint_positions

description: Convenience wrapper to open the gripper fully.
name: open_gripper

description: Convenience wrapper to close the gripper fully.
name: close_gripper

description: Move the robot to a predefined preset pose (e.g., 'HOME', 'MIDDLE').
name: move_to_preset

description: Read current end-effector XYZ position and rotation matrix. Available in sim mode.
name: get_end_effector_pose

description: Move the robot end-effector to a 2D point visible in the camera feed. Provide a normalized [y, x] coordinate (0-1000) from the camera image. The system maps this to 3D workspace coordinates using ArUco workspace calibration and solves inverse kinematics to reach the target. Specify z_height_cm to control vertical offset above table (0 for table contact, 3-5 for hover/transit).
name: move_to_spatial_point

approach.description: Approach mode (REQUIRED): 'top_down' (vertical grasp perpendicular to table, MANDATORY for all tabletop pick-and-place, grasping, and table descends) or 'horizontal' (lateral approach).

point.description: Normalized [y, x] image coordinate (0-1000) of the target.

z_height_cm.description: Height above the table surface in centimeters (default: 3.0). Use 0 for grasping contact at table level, 3-5 for safe hover.
